notes: CHK-010 reference model: the read-side counter RA runs on i_clk_rd and is reset by i_rst_n_rd. A write-domain snapshot (rbase) is taken at every edge where the block is active or either reset is low. This acts as the clear at the end of the software reset. The write-domain counter is cleared at the same edges. occ_q holds OCC_W(t) from the previous write edge, and the o_full_thr check starts from the second edge (r1). CHK-009 and CHK-011 are checked only at i_clk_wr edges. The "right after a change of i_rst_n_sw" case is not covered because it can't be sampled on the clock.
